pairs: Filii autem Ruben et Gad habebant pecora multa,
Now the sons of Ruben and of Gad had many herds,
et erat illis in jumentis infinita substantia.
and their substance in cattle was inestimable.
Cumque vidissent Jazer et Galaad aptas animalibus alendis terras,
And when they had seen that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were suitable for feeding animals,
and the leaders of the multitude,
quam percussit Dominus in conspectu filiorum Israël,
which the Lord has struck in the sight of the sons of Israel,
regio uberrima est ad pastum animalium:
is a very fertile region for pasturing animals.
et nos servi tui habemus jumenta plurima,
And we, your servants, have very many cattle.
precamurque si invenimus gratiam coram te,
And so we beseech you, if we have found favor before you,
ut des nobis famulis tuis eam in possessionem,
that you give it to us, your subjects, as a possession,
and that you not cause us cross the Jordan.”
Numquid fratres vestri ibunt ad pugnam,
Why do you subvert the minds of the sons of Israel,
ne transire audeant in locum, quem eis daturus est Dominus?
so that they might not dare to cross into the place which the Lord will give to them?
Did not your fathers act in the same way,
quando misi de Cadesbarne ad explorandam terram?
when I sent them from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land?
cumque venissent usque ad Vallem botri,
And when they had gone all the way to the Valley of the Cluster of Grapes,
they subverted the hearts of the sons of Israel,
ut non intrarent fines, quos eis Dominus dedit.
so that they would not enter into the parts that the Lord gave to them.
And being angry, the Lord swore an oath,
qui ascenderunt ex Ægypto a viginti annis
quam sub juramento pollicitus sum Abraham,
which I have promised under an oath to Abraham,
For they were not willing to follow me,
except Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite,
and Joshua the son of Nun;
And the Lord, being angry against Israel,
circumduxit eum per desertum quadraginta annis, donec consumeretur universa generatio,
led them in a course through the desert for forty years, until the entire generation,
quæ fecerat malum in conspectu ejus.
which had done evil in his sight, was consumed.
“you have risen up in the place of your fathers,
the offshoots and the nurslings of sinful men,
ut augeretis furorem Domini contra Israël.
in order to augment the fury of the Lord against Israel.
But if you are not willing to follow him,
he will leave the people behind in the wilderness,
et vos causa eritis necis omnium.
and you will have been the cause of all our deaths.”
“We will manufacture sheep pens and cattle stalls,
nos autem ipsi armati et accincti pergemus ad prælium ante filios Israël,
But we ourselves will continue on, armed and girded for battle, before the sons of Israel,
donec introducamus eos ad loca sua.
until we lead them to their places.
and whatever we may be able to have,
because of the treachery of the inhabitants.
We will not return to our houses,
usque dum possideant filii Israël hæreditatem suam:
even until the sons of Israel may possess their inheritance.
Neither will we seek anything across the Jordan,
quia jam habemus nostram possessionem in orientali ejus plaga.
because we already have our possession on its eastern side.”
“If you accomplish what you have promised,
expediti pergite coram Domino ad pugnam:
you may go out, equipped for battle, before the Lord.
et omnis vir bellator armatus Jordanem transeat,
And let every fighting man cross over the Jordan,
until the Lord overthrows his enemies,
and all the land is subjected to him.
tunc eritis inculpabiles apud Dominum et apud Israël,
Then you will be guiltless with the Lord and with Israel,
et obtinebitis regiones, quas vultis, coram Domino.
and you will obtain the regions which you desire before the Lord.
But if you do not do what you have said,
no one could doubt that you will have sinned against God.
nulli dubium est quin peccetis in Deum:
et scitote quoniam peccatum vestrum apprehendet vos.
Therefore, build cities for your little ones,
et caulas, et stabula ovibus ac jumentis:
and pens and stables for your sheep and cattle;
and fulfill what you have promised.”
Dixeruntque filii Gad et Ruben ad Moysen:
And the sons of Gad and of Ruben said to Moses:
we shall do what you, our ruler, orders.
We will leave behind our little ones,
ac jumenta relinquemus in urbibus Galaad:
nos autem famuli tui omnes expediti pergemus ad bellum, sicut tu, domine, loqueris.
And we, your servants, all well-equipped, will go forth to battle, just as you, our ruler, has spoken.”
Therefore, Moses instructed Eleazar the priest,
and Joshua the son of Nun,
et principibus familiarum per tribus Israël,
and the princes of the families throughout the tribes of Israel,
“If the sons of Gad and the sons of Ruben cross over the Jordan with you,
et filii Ruben vobiscum Jordanem omnes armati ad bellum coram Domino,
all armed for war before the Lord,
and if the land becomes subject to you,
give them Gilead as a possession.
Sin autem noluerint transire armati vobiscum in terram Chanaan,
But if they are not willing to cross with you, armed, into the land of Canaan,
then let them receive places among you for their dwellings.”
Responderuntque filii Gad et filii Ruben:
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Ruben responded:
Sicut locutus est Dominus servis suis,
“Just as the Lord has spoken to his servants,
ipsi armati pergemus coram Domino in terram Chanaan,
We will go forth, armed, before the Lord into the land of Canaan;
et possessionem jam suscepisse nos confitemur trans Jordanem.
and we acknowledge that we have already received our possession across the Jordan.”
Dedit itaque Moyses filiis Gad et Ruben,
And so, Moses gave to the sons of Gad and of Ruben,
et dimidiæ tribui Manasse filii Joseph,
and to half the tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph,
the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites,
et terram eorum cum urbibus suis per circuitum.
king of Bashan, and their land with its surrounding cities.
the sons of Gad built up Dibon,
urbes munitas, et caulas pecoribus suis.
as fortified cities with pens for their cattle.
Yet truly, the sons of Ruben built up Heshbon,
et Baalmeon versis nominibus, Sabama quoque:
and Baal-meon (their names having been changed) and Sibmah,
appointing names for the cities which they had built.
Moreover, the sons of Machir, the son of Manasseh,
et vastaverunt eam interfecto Amorrhæo habitatore ejus.
and they devastated it, putting to death its inhabitant, the Amorite.
Dedit ergo Moyses terram Galaad Machir filio Manasse,
Therefore, Moses gave the land of Gilead to Machir, the son of Manasseh,
But Jair, the son of Manasseh,
went out and occupied its villages,
which he called Havoth Jair, that is,
Nobe quoque perrexit, et apprehendit Chanath cum viculis suis:
Likewise, Nobah went forth and captured Kenath with its villages.
vocavitque eam ex nomine suo Nobe.
And he called it by his own name, Nobah.
